authors: Ina Meyer, Lennart Mesecke, Marco-Nicolas Galati, Tatjana Melnyk, Stefan Kaierle, Roland Lachmayer
name: luh-sem-and-edx-characterization-data-of-gas-atomized-316l-and-cucrzr-powders
notes:
This dataset contains scanning electron microscopy (SEM) images and energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy (EDX) measurements of gas-atomized metal powders used in powder bed fusion of metals using a laser beam (PBF-LB/M).

__The dataset comprises powder characterization data for:__

* 316L stainless steel powder supplied by Carpenter Additive (_Widnes, United Kingdom_)
* CuCrZr powder supplied by ECKART TLS GmbH (_Bitterfeld-Wolfen, Germany_)

The SEM images document the particle morphology at different magnifications and scale bars (400 µm, 200 µm, 100 µm, and 50 µm). EDX area analyses were performed on representative powder regions of approximately 500 µm to verify the nominal chemical composition of the powders.
The SEM and EDX measurements were performed at _Laser Zentrum Hannover e.V. (LZH), Hannover, Germany,_ using a 
Quanta FEG 400 ESEM equipped with an EDAX APEX Advanced v3.0 EDX system.

__Dataset Contents:__

* SEM images of 316L powder
* SEM images of CuCrZr powder
* EDX area analyses including all detected elements
* EDX area analyses excluding C, O, and Si for improved comparison with the nominal alloy compositions
* Documentation of measurement conditions and dataset structure

![Representative SEM image of the gas-atomized 316L powder included in this dataset.](https://data.uni-hannover.de/dataset/020020fc-70cf-43c6-b478-b002a616482d/resource/94be8f75-c664-41f3-89a1-008f8de87a1e/download/representative_sem_image.png)
